visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a green t-shirt with a vintage Mini Cooper graphic and khaki cargo pants, walks away from the camera on a paved rural road next to a green rice paddy. A hand enters the frame from the right and taps his shoulder. He stops and turns around with a confused expression. (2) The off-screen person hands the man a small spice jar containing salt. He takes it and looks at it skeptically. The background shows several white cars parked along the field edge under a bright evening sky. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor studio with white walls. Hands are shown assembling a black industrial-style metal rack. A black rubber mallet is used to hammer the crossbeams into the vertical supports. Close-up shots highlight the 'CIAZHAN' branding on the metal. (4) The completed rack is displayed as a functional wardrobe. It features a wooden top shelf holding several model airplanes. Below, a metal rail holds jackets and shirts on hangers. A grey fabric curtain is pulled across the frame on a roller track. (5) Multiple close-ups show the storage details: a flight simulator control panel box, a silver equipment case, and a thick yellow-tabbed manual. The lighting is bright and uniform, emphasizing the clean lines of the furniture. (6) The video concludes with a series of quick cuts showing different types of clothing hung on the rack, including a jacket with a 'Top Gun Maverick' patch, demonstrating the versatility and strength of the storage system.

(3) The narrator transitions into a high-energy, fast-paced promotional delivery. The BGM remains steady. Sharp 'thud' sound effects of a mallet hitting metal are heard clearly over the music. (6) The track ends with a decisive call to action by the narrator in a lower, more authoritative tone, perfectly timed with the final visual branding elements.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Ciazhan's modular metal storage racks by using a humorous skit to grab attention before detailing technical benefits like load capacity, ease of assembly, and customization options.
